scope.boundary: Local Typer CLI, Python dispatcher and analysis functions, outbound provider calls
scope.verification: Source/fixtures and local introspection; no live provider verification
notes: This catalog is not an OpenAPI document or a new server/API implementation.
Pydantic definitions are extracted in validation mode; ordinary properties/aliases are listed separately and are not serialized fields.

Dispatcher outputs use model_dump in Python mode: datetimes can remain datetime objects; listed JSON Schema date-time fields describe their JSON representation, not a promised JSON encoding at that boundary.
Raw provider schemas document partial consumed shapes/fallbacks, not complete provider guarantees.
No schema-wide additionalProperties=false is invented; advertised tool input schemas are not globally enforced.

cli_commands.description: Analyze a trade. Players and picks both count (e.g. --get '2027 1st').

parameters.name: give
parameters.help: What you send, comma-separated.

parameters.name: get
parameters.help: What you receive, comma-separated.

parameters.name: market
parameters.help: Market: fc, ktc, or both (default: both).

output.description: Trade sides, raw and site-adjusted totals, offer rule, provenance, raw position deltas and unresolved/substitution notices

notes: give/get split comma-separated player/pick labels; received assets are side_a and given assets side_b.
market accepts fc, ktc, both and legacy dealer. Unresolved assets and non-exact resolutions are surfaced.
Both markets fetched fresh; displayed verdict totals include ported site package adjustments. Raw position deltas exclude adjustments.
Default both-market offer rule requires <10% gap of larger side in each market and KTC Fair Trade; missing/approximate inputs, redraft or calculator drift produce CANNOT_JUDGE.
Calculator drift checks make text requests to provider pages and changed JS bundles.

response.normalized_python: Dict[str, ChoiceAnswer] -> local interpret -> Route(tool, kwargs)

notes: state contains original query, without appended league data; questions are fixed Choice prompts plus query-derived limit criteria.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.js_round
analysis_functions.python_parameters: x: float
analysis_functions.description: Math.round: halves round up (toward +inf), NaN/inf pass through.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.fc_adjustment
analysis_functions.python_parameters: side1: Sequence[int], side2: Sequence[int]
analysis_functions.description:
FantasyCalc's dynasty waiver adjustment, (side1_adj, side2_adj).

Port of `getValueAdjustment(isDynasty=true, side1, side2)`: equal piece counts or
an empty side get nothing. Otherwise the side sending FEWER pieces is credited
with floor(min(v*0.6982, 753 + i*0.23)) for each of the k lowest-valued pieces
on the other side (k = the piece-count gap, i = 0.. in ascending value order).
Picks are pieces like players.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.ktc_adjustment
analysis_functions.python_parameters: side1: Sequence[int], side2: Sequence[int], top: int, variance: int=KTC_VARIANCE
analysis_functions.description:
KTC's value adjustment. Verbatim port of `adjustPackageNew` (ALGOTOUSE=2).

`top` is `playersArray[0].value`: the most valuable asset on the whole page in
the chosen format/TEP. Returns None when a side is empty (the site then only
prints an "add a player worth ~N" hint, no verdict) or when the Newton solve
fails to converge (the site shows an error). `variance` is the page's slider,
which moves the adjustment as well as the verdict.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.extract_functions
analysis_functions.python_parameters: js: str, name: str
analysis_functions.description:
Source of every definition of `name` in minified JS: `function name(...){...}`
or a class method `name(...){...}`. Calls (`x.name(`, `name(...)` not followed by
a body) are skipped; brace matching ignores braces inside strings.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.normalized_hash
analysis_functions.python_parameters: source: str
analysis_functions.description:
sha256 of JS source with whitespace dropped and short (minifier-renamed)
identifiers replaced by their order of first appearance, so a redeploy that only
renames locals keeps the hash while any change to the formula moves it.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.function_hashes
analysis_functions.python_parameters: js: str, functions: Sequence[str]
analysis_functions.description:
Normalized hash per function name (all definitions concatenated); '' when
the function is gone from the bundle.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.fc_constants
analysis_functions.python_parameters: chunk_js: str
analysis_functions.description: The dynasty constants object that `getValueAdjustment` destructures.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.ktc_constants
analysis_functions.python_parameters: site_js: str

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.calculators.fingerprint_problems
analysis_functions.python_parameters: site: str, bundle_js: str
analysis_functions.description:
Differences between a live bundle and the verified FINGERPRINTS for `site`
('fc' chunk or 'ktc' site.min.js). Empty list = the ported math still applies.

A player's current Sleeper designation: the roster status when that is a

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.cleanup.ir_eligible_statuses
analysis_functions.python_parameters: settings: Dict[str, Any]
analysis_functions.description:
Lowercased designations this league lets onto IR: IR and PUP always, plus

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.cleanup.taxi_eligible
analysis_functions.python_parameters: years_exp: Optional[int], *, allow_vets: bool, taxi_years: Optional[int]
analysis_functions.description:
Whether a player may be stashed on the taxi squad.

Sleeper's taxi rules: if the league allows veterans (`taxi_allow_vets`), any
player qualifies. Otherwise a player qualifies only inside the rookie window,
i.e. experience <= `taxi_years` (and `taxi_years` unset means rookies only).
Unknown experience is treated as ineligible (conservative: never suggest a
move the league might reject).

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.draft.pick_number
analysis_functions.python_parameters: round_: int, slot: int, teams: int, *, snake: bool=False, reversal_round: int=0
analysis_functions.description:
Overall (1-indexed) pick number for a (round, slot).

Linear: every round runs slot 1..teams, so slot S in round R is just
(R-1)*teams + S. Snake: even rounds run in reverse. Third-round reversal
(reversal_round=R, common in dynasty rookie drafts): the direction flips
once more from round R on, so the team that drafted last in round R-1 also
drafts first in round R.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.draft.my_picks
analysis_functions.python_parameters: roster_id: int, slot_to_roster: Dict[int, int], traded_picks: List[Dict[str, Any]], picks_made: List[Dict[str, Any]], *, teams: int, rounds: int, snake: bool=False, reversal_round: int=0
analysis_functions.description:
Every pick `roster_id` currently owns - made and upcoming - by pick number.

`used` is decided by count (a pick is used once `pick_no <= picks made`), so
it stays correct no matter how the draft is ordered; the player who was taken
is read from the matching `picks_made` row when present.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.draft.available
analysis_functions.python_parameters: book: ValueBook, taken_ids: Set[str], *, position: Optional[str]=None, limit: Optional[int]=None
analysis_functions.description:
ValueBook players not in `taken_ids`, ranked by dynasty value.

`taken_ids` is the union of everyone already rostered league-wide and everyone
drafted in this draft - so what's left is exactly what you can still pick. The
ranking itself is `ValueBook.top`, so `values` and `draft` agree on order.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.fit.detect_status
analysis_functions.python_parameters: power_rank: Optional[int], num_teams: int
analysis_functions.description:
Top third of the league -> contend, bottom third -> rebuild, else
balanced. Unknown rank -> balanced.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.fit.starting_assets
analysis_functions.python_parameters: assets: List[Asset], roster_positions: List[str]
analysis_functions.description:
(slot, asset) for the optimal starting lineup, scored by dynasty value (the
laminar greedy assignment from `lineup`).

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.fit.startable_value
analysis_functions.python_parameters: assets: List[Asset], roster_positions: List[str]
analysis_functions.description:
Optimal starting-lineup value over `assets`, scored by dynasty value.

Returns (total starter value, {player_position: starter value}). Reuses the
laminar greedy assignment from `lineup`, so a WR filling a FLEX still counts
under WR.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.fit.positional_standing
analysis_functions.python_parameters: my_val: RosterValuation, all_vals: List[RosterValuation], roster_positions: List[str]
analysis_functions.description: Your startable value per position vs the league median startable value.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.fit.score_candidate
analysis_functions.python_parameters: candidate: Asset, base_starter_value: int, my_assets: List[Asset], roster_positions: List[str], standing_by_pos: Dict[str, PositionStanding], weights: Dict[str, float], status: str, market_rank: int
analysis_functions.description:
Score one available player for this team. Anchor = dynasty value; the
tilts are bounded fractions of that anchor.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.fit.rank_fits
analysis_functions.python_parameters: candidates: List[Asset], my_val: RosterValuation, all_vals: List[RosterValuation], roster_positions: List[str], status: str, limit: int
analysis_functions.description:
Score the value-sorted `candidates` for this team and return the top
`limit` by FitScore, plus the team context for the header. `market_rank` is
captured from the incoming (value-sorted) order before re-sorting.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.lineup.project_points
analysis_functions.python_parameters: stats: Dict[str, Any], scoring: Dict[str, Any]
analysis_functions.description:
Fantasy points for one projected stat line under the league's scoring.

Purely data-driven: multiply every stat key the league scores by its weight.
This already covers position bonuses, because Sleeper's projection exposes
them as their own stat keys - `bonus_rec_te` (TE premium), `bonus_rec_wr`,
`bonus_pass_yd_300`, etc. - each equal to the count it applies to. Do NOT add
TEP separately: the projection's `bonus_rec_te` stat already carries it, so a
manual bonus would double-count. Verified against Sleeper's own
`pts_half_ppr` (WR/TE/K match to the cent).

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.lineup.projected_points
analysis_functions.python_parameters: roster: Roster, projections: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], scoring: Dict[str, Any], players_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
analysis_functions.description: player_id -> {name, position, points} for everyone on the roster.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.lineup.starting_slots
analysis_functions.python_parameters: roster_positions: List[str]
analysis_functions.description:
The ordered starting slots we optimize (duplicates kept, e.g. two 'RB').

Bench tokens (BN/IR/TAXI) and unsupported overlapping flexes are dropped, so
the result is exactly the laminar slots the greedy assignment is optimal for.

analysis_functions.python_parameters: roster: Roster, projections: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], scoring: Dict[str, Any], roster_positions: List[str], players_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, season: str='', week: int=0, weekly: Optional[WeeklyContext]=None, required_start: Optional[str]=None, exclude: Optional[set]=None, contingencies: bool=True

analysis_functions.python_parameters: fact: WeeklyPlayer

analysis_functions.python_parameters: fact: WeeklyPlayer, weekly: WeeklyContext

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.movers.value_redraft_gap
analysis_functions.python_parameters: a: Asset, min_value: int=1000
analysis_functions.description:
(dynasty - redraft) / redraft * 100, or None when not comparable.

None for a pick, a player with no redraft value, or either value below
`min_value` - so callers (movers, fit) degrade to a neutral signal instead of
a meaningless +100000% gap on a deep stash with redraft ~1. Positive means
dynasty > redraft (young/ascending); negative means aging win-now value.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.movers.top_movers
analysis_functions.python_parameters: book: ValueBook, buy: bool=False, limit: int=20, min_value: int=1000
analysis_functions.description:
Return (asset, gap_pct) ranked.

gap_pct = (dynasty - redraft) / redraft * 100.
  buy=True  -> dynasty >> redraft first (buy-low, young upside).
  buy=False -> redraft >> dynasty first (sell-high, aging win-now value).

`min_value` floors BOTH values so the list is real contributors. Without it,
deep stashes with redraft ~1 produce meaningless +100000% gaps and bury the
genuine buy-lows. Players below the floor in either value are dropped.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.movers.find_arbitrage_movers
analysis_functions.python_parameters: rosters: Optional[Union[List[Roster], ValueBook]]=None, book: Optional[ValueBook]=None, min_value: int=1000, limit: int=20, market: Optional[str]=None
analysis_functions.description:
Scan and rank assets with market valuation discrepancies between FC and secondary market (Dynasty Dealer).

If rosters is supplied, attaches owning team info to each arbitrage opportunity.
market can be 'dealer' (assets where Dealer > FC) or 'fc' (assets where FC > Dealer).
Accepts 'ktc' as a legacy alias for 'dealer'.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.picks.pick_tier
analysis_functions.python_parameters: power_rank: Optional[int], num_teams: int
analysis_functions.description:
Early/mid/late from the ORIGINAL team's power rank: better team, later
pick. Thirds, like `detect_status`; unknown rank prices neutrally as mid.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.picks.price_pick
analysis_functions.python_parameters: book: ValueBook, season: str, round_: int, tier: str
analysis_functions.description:
(value, tier_used) for a (season, round) pick. Tiered entry when
FantasyCalc has one, else the flat round entry (tier_used=None), else 0.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.picks.pick_ledger
analysis_functions.python_parameters: rosters: List[Roster], traded_picks: List[Dict[str, Any]], book: ValueBook, power_ranks: Dict[int, Optional[int]], *, seasons: List[str], rounds: int
analysis_functions.description:
Every team's future picks, reconciled and valued, best capital first.

`rounds` is the caller's best guess at the rookie-draft round count; a traded
pick in a deeper round proves the draft has at least that many, so the ledger
extends itself rather than silently dropping owned capital.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.roster.value_roster
analysis_functions.python_parameters: roster: Roster, book: ValueBook, players_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None
analysis_functions.description:
Build a priced valuation for one roster.

Players FantasyCalc covers contribute their dynasty value; everyone else
(kickers, defenses, deep bench) is listed under `unvalued` at value 0 so the
roster view is still complete.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.roster.value_all_rosters
analysis_functions.python_parameters: rosters: List[Roster], book: ValueBook, players_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None
analysis_functions.description: Value every roster and assign power ranks (1 = most valuable).

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.trade.evaluate_trade
analysis_functions.python_parameters: give_inputs: Optional[List[str]]=None, get_inputs: Optional[List[str]]=None, book: Optional[ValueBook]=None, *, give: Optional[List[str]]=None, get: Optional[List[str]]=None, include_secondary: bool=True, include_ktc: bool=True, players_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None
analysis_functions.description: Evaluate trade given assets to give and assets to receive.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.trade.analyze_trade
analysis_functions.python_parameters: side_a_tokens: List[str], side_b_tokens: List[str], book: ValueBook, labels: Tuple[str, str]=('Side A', 'Side B'), include_secondary: bool=True, include_ktc: bool=True, players_meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None
analysis_functions.description:
Returns (evaluation, unresolved_tokens).

The evaluation is symmetric in the two sides; `delta` is `value_a - value_b`,
so whichever list you pass as side_a is the side that "wins" when delta > 0.
The CLI passes what you receive as side_a and what you give as side_b, so a
positive delta means the trade favors you. Unresolved tokens are surfaced,
never silently dropped - a missing player would otherwise make a trade look
lopsided.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.trade.apply_site_adjustments
analysis_functions.python_parameters: evaluation: TradeEvaluation
analysis_functions.description:
Set both sites' package adjustments on the sides (side_a = the site's Team 1).

FantasyCalc: its dynasty waiver adjustment (redraft is not modeled, so it stays
None there). KTC: its value adjustment, only when every asset has a KTC value
and KTC's top value is known; a failed solve leaves it None.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.trade.offer_verdict
analysis_functions.python_parameters: evaluation: TradeEvaluation, threshold_pct: float=OFFER_THRESHOLD_PCT, calculator_problems: Sequence[str]=()
analysis_functions.description:
The offer rule, judged only on numbers the sites themselves would show.

PASS: on the site-adjusted totals the gap is under `threshold_pct` of the larger
side in FantasyCalc AND in KTC, and KTC's own verdict reads "Fair Trade".
CANNOT_JUDGE when any input the sites would need is missing, or when a site's
calculator code has changed since ff's port was verified (`calculator_problems`,
from ff.values.calculators_live).

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.trade.position_deltas
analysis_functions.python_parameters: evaluation: TradeEvaluation
analysis_functions.description:
Net RAW value gained per position from side A's perspective (A minus B);
package adjustments belong to no position.

analysis_functions.name: ff.analysis.trade.secondary_position_deltas
analysis_functions.python_parameters: evaluation: TradeEvaluation
analysis_functions.description: Net RAW secondary market value gained per position from side A's perspective (A minus B).

auxiliary_script_boundaries.output: Human-readable passing packages, site-adjusted totals, percentages, lineup gain, incoming roles/flags and pick origin/tier. Pure search returns Python row dictionaries.
auxiliary_script_boundaries.errors: argparse usage or unowned/unpriced --sell exits 2; calculator drift exits 1; an unknown --to manager is printed and skipped (the run may exit 0); unresolved --with balancers are omitted; uncaught config/provider/roster failures may propagate; no transaction execution
auxiliary_script_boundaries.notes: Uses one fresh values fetch and calculator drift verification, named manager-owned assets and tiered future picks. Separate script, not an ff command.

inputs.--check: fixture filename; recompute with live site JS
inputs.--eval: stdin JSON {fc_params, ktc_tep, ktc_format, ktc_html?, trades:[{side1, side2}]}

auxiliary_script_boundaries.output: JSON vectors, parity-check results or site values/adjustments/totals/verdicts to stdout; no files unless shell redirected
auxiliary_script_boundaries.notes: Fetches provider calculator pages/bundles and values endpoint; executes extracted source in node:vm for parity testing, outside application runtime.

cli_usage.shape: Terminal usage/error text; no JSON envelope

cli_expected.notes: _guard also maps Pydantic ValidationError and JSONDecodeError to a corrupt/outdated-config message. It does not catch every exception.

jev_clarification.shape: Plain clarification message; no result/tool execution for interpretation refusal

local_ask_printed_failure.shape: Printed warning/error followed by normal return; no uniform error JSON
local_ask_printed_failure.notes: Strict QA can raise instead. Runner failures use cli_expected/exit 1; failures outside these catches may propagate.

qa_strict.shape: QAInvariantError(command, errors: List[str]); message begins QA invariant violation in '<command>'
qa_strict.notes: Ordinary uncaught-exception process exit, not a friendly error explicitly handled by _guard. In non-strict modes, QA emits reports/warnings instead.

triggers: weekly request incompatible with current-week snapshot
dispatcher_value_error.notes: No process exit code at the function boundary; the caller decides how to report it.

public_http.shape: Requests exception (HTTPError/connection/timeout) or JSON decoding error; no normalized upstream error body
public_http.notes: GET retries 429/500/502/503/504 up to four times; timeout 30 seconds. Corrupt cached JSON is refetched. Guarded CLI maps errors to cli_expected.

secondary_degraded.shape: Empty normalized secondary mapping / Asset.secondary_value = null; often logged warning
secondary_degraded.notes: Optional fetch/parse failure degrades rather than aborting primary valuation. No promised provider error envelope.

unexpected_exception.notes: Not all file I/O or programming errors are handled by _guard.

calculator_drift.shape: List[str] of missing/changed bundle or formula problems, including safe exception class names
calculator_drift.notes: Problems make direct both-market trade OfferVerdict CANNOT_JUDGE rather than trusting stale calculator math. get_text uses browser User-Agent and TLS-only curl fallback, without JSON-session retries.

model_compatibility.Asset: Before validation, missing/null secondary_value accepts ktc_value then dealer_value; both alias properties proxy secondary_value. Output stores canonical secondary_value.
model_compatibility.ArbitrageMover: Legacy dealer_value/ktc_value constructor/property compatibility maps to canonical secondary_value; see model validator.
model_compatibility.string_domains: Many domain fields (kind, slot, availability, competitive status) are str with comments, not enforced Literal enums. Preserve actual Pydantic schema.

Asset.description: A tradeable thing: a player or a draft pick, with its dynasty value.
Asset.title: Asset

ArbitrageMover.description: An asset with valuation discrepancies across FantasyCalc and secondary market (Dynasty Dealer / KTC).
ArbitrageMover.title: ArbitrageMover

Lineup.description: An optimal starting lineup for one week plus the leftover bench.
Lineup.title: Lineup

LineupSlot.description: One starting slot (or a bench entry) with its projected player.
LineupSlot.title: LineupSlot

DraftFit.description:
One available player scored for *this* team: market value (the anchor)
adjusted by roster-fit and win-now/rebuild horizon.
DraftFit.title: DraftFit

DraftPickInfo.description: One draft pick a roster owns - upcoming, or already used on a player.
DraftPickInfo.title: DraftPickInfo

Format.description:
A league's scoring/roster format - everything needed to ask FantasyCalc
for the *right* values. Derived from Sleeper's own league settings so it is
always correct for the user's league (never guessed).
Format.title: Format

FuturePick.description:
One future rookie-draft pick a roster currently owns.

Sleeper has no per-team pick endpoint: ownership is the default endowment
(every team owns its own pick per season/round) reconciled with the league's
`traded_picks`. `tier` records which FantasyCalc tier priced it (early/mid/
late, from the original team's power rank), None when only the flat round
value existed.
FuturePick.title: FuturePick

NewsItem.description:
One headline from Sleeper's per-player news feed.

The feed is undocumented and its `metadata` block varies by source (a real
10-item sample carried `url` on 6 and `analysis` on 7), so every field but
the title/description pair is optional and parsing never raises.
NewsItem.title: NewsItem

OfferVerdict.description:
The offer rule: the gap on the site-adjusted totals is under `threshold_pct`
of the larger side in BOTH FantasyCalc and KTC, and KTC's own verdict is
"Fair Trade". CANNOT_JUDGE lists why (missing prices, redraft, drifted site
code...), so a verdict is never reported on numbers the sites would not show.
OfferVerdict.title: OfferVerdict

PositionStanding.description: Where one roster stands at a position vs the league, by startable value.
PositionStanding.title: PositionStanding

Roster.description: A team in the league, as Sleeper reports it (before valuation).
Roster.title: Roster

RosterSlot.description:
One rostered player, categorized by where they sit, with the signals a
roster-cleanup decision needs: value, age/experience, and taxi eligibility.
RosterSlot.title: RosterSlot

RosterAudit.description:
A roster's capacity vs its fill, plus ranked drop, IR-move, and taxi-move
suggestions - the input to a cleanup decision. Pure, deterministic.
RosterAudit.title: RosterAudit

RosterValuation.description: A team's roster priced out with dynasty values.
RosterValuation.title: RosterValuation

TeamContext.description:
A team's competitive status and positional standing - the lens a draft
recommendation is made through.
TeamContext.title: TeamContext

TeamPicks.description: Every future pick one roster owns, valued - a team's draft capital.
TeamPicks.title: TeamPicks

TradeEvaluation.description:
Result of analyzing a proposed trade between two sides.

`value_*` / `secondary_value_*` are the totals each calculator site would show,
i.e. raw sums plus the side's adjustment (see `TradeSide`); `raw_*` are the
plain sums. side_a is the site's Team 1.
TradeEvaluation.title: TradeEvaluation

WaiverTarget.description: A trending add joined to its dynasty value and roster availability.
WaiverTarget.title: WaiverTarget

WeeklyPlayer.description: Fresh weekly facts; unknown data is explicit, never a guessed healthy player.
WeeklyPlayer.title: WeeklyPlayer

Config.description: The saved league. Written once by `ff setup`, read by every command.
Config.title: Config

QACheck.description: An individual assertion or sanity check performed during QA.
QACheck.title: QACheck

QAReport.description: Aggregated QA report containing results of all checks for a command.
QAReport.title: QAReport
